note: Page.printToPDF is the print-preview and Save-as-PDF pipeline. Headless Chrome does not open a print dialog for Ctrl+P and does not fire beforeprint for that key event. The Print button calls window.print(), which does fire beforeprint; the PDF for that path is then captured with Page.printToPDF.

ctrl_p.statement: Headless Ctrl+P did not open a print dialog and did not fire beforeprint. The shortcut is a browser UI accelerator. The print pipeline that Ctrl+P, print preview, and Save as PDF use was captured with Page.printToPDF.
